scripts.cf:login: node scripts/wrangler.mjs login --scopes account:read user:read workers:write workers_scripts:write d1:write
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:staging: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.cf:tail:staging: node scripts/wrangler.mjs tail --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging --format pretty
scripts.test: node --experimental-transform-types --test --test-isolation=none tests/game.test.mjs tests/expansion.test.mjs tests/stage2.test.mjs tests/stage3.test.mjs tests/pwa.test.mjs tests/management.test.mjs tests/host-key.test.mjs tests/recovery.test.mjs tests/security.test.mjs tests/live.test.mjs tests/templates-replay.test.mjs tests/admin.test.mjs tests/i18n.test.mjs tests/assassin.test.mjs tests/player-notes.test.mjs tests/speech.test.mjs tests/record.test.mjs tests/screen.test.mjs tests/guide-theme.test.mjs tests/v12.test.mjs tests/push.test.mjs tests/submit-status.test.mjs tests/solo.test.mjs tests/account.test.mjs tests/achievements.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
